name: Legacy

videos.overview: Felicity and Elizabeth are both struggling to come to terms with what having (or not having) children. Robbie throws a spanner in the works and Msizi and Sandra’s plans are put on hold.

videos.title: Baby steps
videos.overview: Robbie refuses to let Msizi get away with what he knows to be true regarding the contamination of the wetland. He confronts Msizi and Legacy about it. All the talk about SJ and Petra’s baby, Elna, sends Elizabeth into a spin. She is encouraged to start putting herself out there and start dating again.

videos.title: A thin line between love and hate
videos.overview: Msizi sends in a human stealth bomb in the form of Sandra to try and disarm Robbie but Robbie refuses to be deterred from the fight. Elizabeth takes the plunge into the world of online dating. Sanele gets all hot under the collar from another employee.

videos.title: A desert of money
videos.overview: Sanele can’t believe his luck as his friendship with Jabu becomes Not Safe For Work. A showdown in the boardroom ends in a shocking resignation: a Price is leaving Legacy.

videos.title: Cause and effect
videos.overview: Elizabeth is ready to give up on love, but will a business associate of Angelique brighten up her Valentine’s Day? As the court case begins, Janet’s worst fears are coming true: Legacy has brought a squad of lawyers to take down Robbie and Cranston.

videos.title: Lust
videos.overview: In her quest to land a man, Elizabeth enlists Dineo as her wingwoman… and almost immediately sees results. As Sanele spoils his new boy, his friends start to wonder if Jabu might be too good to be true.

videos.title: Hearts and minds
videos.overview: As Sandra pulls out the stops in her court battle against Robbie, Msizi receives some unexpected news. Sanele’s been struck by Cupid’s arrow, but Jabu is bleeding him of more than just love…Egged on by Lexi, Elizabeth’s quest to find Mr. Right enters a new chapter.

videos.title: Desperate times, desperate measures
videos.overview: Nerves are high as Msizi and Robbie prepare for their final day in court. Elizabeth makes a tough decision that could affect the rest of her life

videos.title: Lonely roots
videos.overview: Robbie is determined to fix what was lost by bumping heads with Msizi. Elizabeth makes a decision that shocks Angelique to the core. The Potgieters adjust to Jabu’s presence in their home.

videos.title: Do or die!
videos.overview: Robbie and Sandra’s plans to ride off into the sunset hit another stumbling block. Sanele’s love life unceremonious implodes on the entire Potgieter family. Elizabeth’s journey to motherhood is challenged by an internal battle

videos.title: Dangerous games
videos.overview: Elizabeth gets ready for the biggest decision of her life. Sanele, Willem, and Charmaine clash on how they handled the Jabu situation. Who is in the right?

videos.title: Expecting better
videos.overview: As Elizabeth prepares for IVF and to become a single mom, fate puts her in charm’s way. Robbie gives Sandra the romantic surprise of her life. As Willem and Charmaine fret over losing Sanele, Jabu reveals something about his secret life…

videos.title: Lovestruck
videos.overview: Fate intervenes in Elizabeth’s plans in the form of a dashing man named Max - sparks fly! Robbie and Sandra play cat and mouse as Sanele decamps to Tembisa and gets drawn deeper into Jabu’s thrall…

videos.title: First date flutters
videos.overview: Elizabeth feels like Max may well be Mister Right for her. Sandra’s dinner with the Hugos starts off shaky but ends up improving after some appealing revelations. Sanele offers to arrange a surprise for Jabu's son.

videos.title: When the heart is full, the mouth runs over
videos.overview: Angelique cautions Elizabeth not to rush in, but Elizabeth and Max find themselves in love. Robbie tries to get closer to Sandra, but she pushes him away when he pushes too hard. The Potgieters agree to let Sanele host Kamo’s birthday party at the house, but Sanele may have bitten off more than he can chew.

videos.title: The rule of love
videos.overview: Sandra has to decide whether to let love into her life, knowing it will mess up her plans. Max meets the family and everyone loves him. Elizabeth thinks she's hit the jackpot but is uneasy when she mentions children and Max doesn't react the way she’d hoped.

videos.title: The G-word
videos.overview: Max drops a bombshell on Elizabeth. Sanele asks Jabu for the truth, and is shocked by the answer he gets.

videos.title: Stalemate
videos.overview: Elizabeth is caught in a Catch 22 regarding her relationship with Max and tries to convince him to change his mind about having children. Sims and Stefan try and impress the Mayor as he comes to check on how ‘The Brightside’ is getting on. Robbie asks for Sandra’s help regarding his family’s life insurance policy.

videos.title: Baby blues
videos.overview: Elizabeth struggles to deal with losing Max. But she doesn’t know if it's for the best so she can have kids. Sandra and Robbie clash over the Legacy payout to Suzette and Jana.Things escalate and Dineo orders them to fix it.

videos.title: Paying dues
videos.overview: Robbie is caught wrong footed by a decision Sandra makes post their corporate sparring. Elizabeth throws caution to the wind and chooses to live in the now. Sims and Stefan’s decision on the Mayor’s request incites an unexpected reaction from the Mayor.

videos.title: Charming attempts
videos.overview: Elizabeth and Max have a serious discussion about the state of their relationship. Sims and Stefan gets a surprising reaction from the mayor that changes their lives. Robbie attempts to apologise to Sandra, but might be too late.

videos.title: A hard pill to swallow
videos.overview: Elizabeth is caught between choosing what she always wanted and a future with the man she loves. Msizi finds himself in a compromised position when it comes to choosing a new Head of Legal to work with him.

videos.title: Compromised
videos.overview: As Angelique takes on her new role, Dineo’s attempts to make amends for earlier slights leads to an explosive dinner party. With Brightside’s future in the balance, Sims and Stefan find themselves at loggerheads over the mayoral bribe.

videos.title: Big little lies
videos.overview: Angelique discovers something that could potentially see the Prices regain control of the family empire. She plays nice with Msizi and Dineo to give herself an advantage. What is meant to be the best day of her life turns out to be a nightmare for Elizabeth when Max discovers her betrayal.

videos.title: Suspicious minds
videos.overview: Elizabeth deals with the aftermath of Max discovering her plan to trick him about birth control. Sims isn't happy with what Brightside did to stay afloat. He thinks it's only the start of them compromising their morals.

videos.title: To have and to hold
videos.overview: Angelique pushes her agenda of Msizi and Dineo getting married without either of them being too suspicious of her motives. Robbie gets a worrying call from the Game Academy informing him of Ben’s disappearance. Sims’ worst fears come true when the Mayor shows up unannounced, demanding more favors.

videos.title: Errand boys
videos.overview: Msizi’s marriage proposal results in a shocking twist. Robbie and Cranston search for Ben, and make a horrifying discovery.

videos.title: Dead end
videos.overview: Angelique lays her plans of regaining Legacy as Dineo and Msizi find themselves in a romantic deadlock. Robbie and Cranston go in search of missing Ben - is he alive or dead?

videos.title: Out in the cold
videos.overview: Angelique tries her best to patch things up with Dineo and Msizi, and tries every tactic to ensure Dineo accepts his proposal. Janet is frantic about Ben still being missing. Robbie and Cranston lead another search party to try and find him.

videos.title: Tears for fears
videos.overview: Dineo reveals her deep-seated fear and the reason she’s scared to remarry. The chances of Robbie finding Ben unharmed grow slimmer by the minute. Willem warns Stefan that he’s playing a very dangerous game.

videos.title: Angelique triumphant
videos.overview: Angelique's wedding plans come to fruition. Robbie is losing hope of ever finding Ben.

videos.title: Missing person
videos.overview: The Hugos start to lose hope in their search for Ben. Msizi is determined to do whatever it takes to marry Dineo.

videos.title: Silver lining/dark cloud
videos.overview: Angelique is victorious, as the moment she’s been waiting for comes to fruition. Robbie is in a predicament and decides to take matters into his own hands. Stefan is worried about Willem’s wellbeing after the stressful period they’ve been through.

videos.title: Your big clever plan
videos.overview: A negotiation with Ben’s kidnapper goes terribly wrong. A mysterious package for Dineo contains a shocking revelation.

videos.title: And the corner office goes to...?
videos.overview: Angelique seeks support for her motion to replace Dineo as CEO and the board meets to vote. Robbie fears the kidnappers have gone underground, and he seeks the help of Sefako to track them down. Charmaine and Stefan’s worry mounts as Willem displays more signs of forgetfulness.

videos.title: From bad to worse
videos.overview: Robbie prepares to exchange the ransom for Ben… but Sefako is starting to think that something is off… While Angelique gloats at her victory, Msizi tries to convince Dineo to start a new company with him. But Dineo has vengeance in mind… Willem continues to deteriorate, and Stefan and Charmaine start to fear the worst.

videos.title: Love's labour's lost
videos.overview: Dineo starts planning to fight back against Angelique. Sefako is suspicious about details of Robbie’s kidnapping. Willem refuses Charmaine’s and Stefan’s request for him to seek medical help.

videos.title: Between a rock (and a hard place)
videos.overview: The Hugo family do whatever they can to raise the R5 million in ransom money for Ben. Dineo is determined to fight for her job and career back, even if it means possibly losing Msizi. Charmaine and Stefan insist that Willem sees a doctor.

videos.title: To do or die
videos.overview: Angelique an Dineo go head to head in court. Each woman proves to be a battle axe in her own right. Stefan And Charmaine face the prospect of watching their father get ravaged by a disease that will leave them both unrecognizable to him.

videos.title: Hard choices
videos.overview: Dineo finds herself between a rock and a hard place when Msizi gives her an ultimatum. The Potgieters find it more difficult to deal with the spanner that’s been thrown into their lives. Felicity returns.

videos.title: Better off alone
videos.overview: Charmaine and Stefan do their best to rally as Willem struggles to keep his grip on reality. As Dineo struggles to mount a winning legal defense against Angelique’s onslaught, she welcomes home an unexpected ally…

videos.title: That which remains
videos.overview: Robbie and Janet get news about Ben, what they will do with that news remains to be seen. Felicity feels she can negotiate a compromise, Angelique feels otherwise. Willem has all his tests done, but to no avail.

videos.title: Opposing forces of nature
videos.overview: Willem gets his MRI results back and is furious with his family about meddling in his affairs. Felicity manages to convince Dineo and Angelique to accept her proposal and discuss a way foward. Robbie and Janet struggle to come to terms with Ben’s death.

videos.title: All is lost
videos.overview: The battle between Angelique and Dineo for the soul of Legacy and the heart of the Price family reaches court and there can be only one victor. The Hugo family mourn the loss of Ben and receive one more startling revelation. Willem is in critical condition and Stefan fears he may lose his father forever.

videos.title: Judgement Day
videos.overview: It's judgement day for Dineo at court. Will she win or lose? Stefan worries that Willem may have had his accident on purpose. Was Willem trying to commit suicide?

videos.title: Things fall apart
videos.overview: Things become tense at Legacy after Angelique takes over as CEO. The Potgieters struggle to come to terms with Willem’s fate.

videos.title: The ugly truth
videos.overview: Willem’s ever declining state sends his family into disarray and Stefan and Charmaine find themselves in a very compromised and conflicting position. Dineo makes a move that has her even more isolated. Robbie finds himself confronted by the ugly truth of white privilege in his endeavour to make a difference.

videos.title: Ring-ring
videos.overview: Willem makes a miraculous recovery, but Charmaine and Stefan are tortured by what they’ve done behind his back. Angelique gloats over defeating Dineo. But Dineo swears she will have justice, and plays the only desperate hand she has left…

videos.title: When the skeletons come calling
videos.overview: Dineo plants a seed in Angelique’s head about who killed Sebastian. Stefan and Charmaine struggle to put on a united front. Dineo puts Sefako on the spot when she asks him to pick a side.

videos.title: Fickle fortune
videos.overview: Angelique sets her doubts in Felicity aside, and Dineo resolves to prove the truth to Angelique. Willem returns home from the hospital full of gratitude for his family’s support, and Charmaine and Stefan are riddled with guilt.

videos.title: More questions than answers
videos.overview: Angelique is on the verge of finding out the truth about what Felicity has done. Denise plans something special for Janet. Willem struggles through his recovery after his accident.

videos.title: The truth will out
videos.overview: Willem makes a startling discovery about his dementia. Dineo threatens Felicity with her darkest secret. Janet learns the importance of family...

videos.title: The truth is a noose
videos.overview: Felicity has a lot of convincing to do in order to stay out of jail. Stefan needs to move out of the house after he and Charmaine tainted the family home.

videos.title: The thicket of lies
videos.overview: Felicity believes Dineo is ready to compromise… but Dineo would rather see Legacy fall than accept a deal… As Stefan and Charmaine grapple with their guilt, Willem starts to suspect that Charmaine is hiding something.

videos.title: House of secrets
videos.overview: Felicity berates Dineo for overplaying her hand and accuses her of dooming them both. Angelique makes a difficult decision to turn her back on a loved one. Willem picks up on the tension in his home and confronts Charmaine about it.

videos.title: Matricidal mania
videos.overview: Felicity runs out of options with Angelique, and takes the most drastic step of all… Charmaine and Stefan fear Willem has overheard the one thing he can never hear.

videos.title: Cruel justice
videos.overview: The aftermath of Felicity pulling a gun on her mother. Can their relationship survive? Stefan and Charmaine sink into paranoia, wondering if Willem overheard them talking about what happened between them.

videos.title: Moving on
videos.overview: Angelique resigns as CEO, and Dineo reclaims her place at the top. Felicity says her farewells and cautions Angelique not to make the same mistake of being consumed by Legacy, that she made. Charmaine resolves not to tell Willem of her infidelity, and to move ahead with their wedding.

videos.title: The Queen is dead. Long live The Queen
videos.overview: Gordon and Elizabeth start to wonder if something sinister is behind Angelique’s decision to step down. A worried Willem decides to confront Charmaine and Stefan.

videos.title: Playing with fire
videos.overview:
Gordon and Elizabeth are determined to find out the real reason behind the sudden change in CEOs. Dineo relishes in regaining her role as CEO, unleashing her wrath on the Prices who betrayed her.

Charmaine and Stefan struggle to come to terms with a way forward as their guilt causes them immense inner and outer turmoil. Willem’s suspicions grow.

videos.title: First dance
videos.overview: As Willem gets swept up in wedding fever, Charmaine and Stefan have a difficult choice to make… Freshly returned to her corner office as CEO, Dineo locks horns with Angelique, leading to temporary ceasefire. Gordon and Angelique are shocked to find two intruders swimming in their pool…

videos.title: Interesting visitors
videos.overview: The Potgieter’s welcome two much needed visitors at their house. Gordon expresses his fears over the new Price visitors.

videos.title: All that glitters
videos.overview: Maddie hatches a plan to get Gordon on her side. Wedding preparations go full steam ahead, but Charmaine is feeling the pressure.

videos.title: Betrothed and betrayed
videos.overview: Maddie and Chloe plot against the Prices… but a surprise visit home by Gordon could upend their plans… Will Charmaine be able to keep her secrets, and marry Willem? Or will her betrayal ruin the happiest day of his life.

videos.title: Cheaters never prosper
videos.overview: Willem demands all the details of the affair Charmaine and Stefan had. Maddie and Chloe worm their way into Angelique's heart. Gordon has other ideas.

videos.title: Facing the music
videos.overview: Sisters, Maddie and Chloe react very differently to the kindnesses that Gordon and Angelique show them. Maddie takes full advantage, while Chloe cannot believe the genuine generosity. Gordon airs his concerns about Maddie to Robbie. Then takes his advice… Charmaine tries her best to iron out things with Willem.

videos.title: Endings and beginnings
videos.overview: The gulf between the newlyweds becomes untenable, forcing Charmaine to make a decision. Maddie warns Chloe not to sell her out or Chloe will suffer terrible consequences. Maddie meets Robbie and the encounter prompts her to adjust her plan.

videos.title: Hard exit
videos.overview: Maddie plots to draw Robbie into her web, but her overtures aren’t having the desired effect. Willem makes a deeply painful decision about his family, his home… and his wife.

videos.title: Bothered
videos.overview: Charmaine drops a life-changing bombshell on Stefan. Maddie is the victim of a terrifying attack - but all isn’t as it seems.

videos.title: Cold comfort
videos.overview: As Maddie makes a play for an unsuspecting Robbie, Liz and Sanele move to prevent her. As Charmaine covers for Willem’s shock walkout, the cogs turn for Petra - she suspects something deeper is going on...

videos.title: Saints and sinners
videos.overview: The Potgieter house is still wound up in secrets and tension with Willem still MIA and Petra getting more suspicious by the day. Maddie’s ever widening web ensnares Robbie even more deeply while Gordon flails about to expose her.

videos.title: Wild child
videos.overview: Willem has his first encounter with Stefan since finding out about Stefan’s betrayal. Robbie falls for Maddie, still unaware of her personal agenda with him.

videos.title: The truth hurts
videos.overview: Robbie and Maddie's relationship heats up, much to Gordon’s horror. Petra deals with finding out what Stefan and Charmaine did behind her father's back.

videos.title: Reparation and protection
videos.overview:
Charmaine and Stefan continue to deeply regret what happened between them as Magda confronts them both. They find comfort in the support from a very unlikely ally - (Petra).

Robbie confronts Gordon about meddling in his relationship with Maddie. Gordon is astounded at the lengths Maddie will go to, to get what she wants. Robbie asks Maddie to be his girlfriend and invites her to dinner to

videos.title: Finessing and forgiveness
videos.overview: Maddie brings Robbie more firmly under her thumb. Gordon warns Angelique to bite her tongue or suffer a backlash. Petra pleads with Willem to find the strength to save their family.

videos.title: An unexpected turn
videos.overview: Willem makes a difficult decision as he tries to come to terms with what happened between Stefan and Charmaine. Robbie feels caught between the two main women in his life.

videos.title: Cut it out
videos.overview: Maddie urges Robbie to claim his birthright, and Dineo and Angelique are alarmed by the results. Petra and Charmaine try to talk to Willem one last time.

videos.title: Out with the old, in with the new
videos.overview: Maddie manipulates Robbie into doing her bidding, and Janet turns to an unlikely ally to remove Maddie from Robbie’s life. Charmaine and Stefan struggle with moving on, but Willem doggedly removes every trace of them from his life and resolves to go on with a clean chapter.

videos.title: My fair share
videos.overview: Angelique arranges a future for Maddie, that doesn’t include Robbie. Petra pushes Willem to a point of forgiveness.

videos.title: When you know you know
videos.overview: As Angelique plots to rid the Price family of Maddie, Maddie plays her masterstroke. Willem must finally face his betrayers, and open his heart to the healing power of grace if his family is to survive. But can he?

videos.title: Leaving on a jet plane
videos.overview: It's time for Petra to go back to the States. Can she leave things healthy between Willem and Stefan?. Maddie furthers her plan to separate Robbie from his family.

videos.title: I got the power
videos.overview: Maddie decides she wants to throw an engagement party and ropes in her sister, Chloe, in a plan to blindside Janet. After almost losing his life by confronting the cable thieves, Stefan is determined to seek help as the power outages continue to cause havoc.

videos.title: Terms of engagement
videos.overview: Maddie’s increased machinations cause an ever-widening gulf between Robbie and Janet. Stefan relies on his police background to try and solve a widespread community issue affecting Brightside and Willem. Dineo’s unimpressed with the ideas Gordon puts forward for the stokvel project.

videos.title: Ready Aim Fire
videos.overview: Maddie reaches a new low in her attempt to drive a wedge between Robbie and his family. The winds of change are blowing at Legacy, and Dineo is masterfully taking charge of it. Sims and Stefan find themselves in a life-threatening situation.

videos.title: Something feels off
videos.overview: Angelique thinks she might have a secret weapon to use against Maddie. A showdown between Gordon and Dineo results in a shocking boardroom revelation.

videos.title: Ignote a spy
videos.overview: While Dineo and Sefako move on the Stokvel project, Gordon finds himself feeling alienated. Maddie works her manipulative magic on Robbie, but two old enemies join forces to put an end to her reign. With cable theft continuing unabated, Stefan comes up with an audacious plan. But Sims is unsure…

videos.title: Cable guys
videos.overview: As Maddie sets the next phase of her devious plan in motion, Angelique and her sleuth Sanele are hot on her trail. Stefan and Sims decide set out to shadow the cable thieves and follow the money… but instead wind up in hot water.

videos.title: Truths of true love
videos.overview: Janet gets Chloe to confess to assisting Maddie in her manipulation, and the scales fall from Robbie’s eyes. Dineo embraces the insights from Sefako and Kedibone and asks the Legacy board to back their stokvel project to the tune of half a billion Rand.

videos.title: Money makes money!
videos.overview: Dineo encounters a hurdle in her endeavour to make Legacy great, making enemies out of old allies. Robbie’s life comes crashing down, taking Maddie’s grand plans with. Stefan and Sims undertake a dangerous mission.

videos.title: Against all odds
videos.overview: Dineo is determined to prove that she has what it takes to run Legacy despite what the Prices may think. Elizabeth says her farewells. Robbie deals with the end of him and Maddie.

videos.title: Jog on
videos.overview: Gordon suspects he’s being sidelined by Dineo. And it turns out he’s right. Stefan and Sims go undercover selling copper scrap, and find themselves staring down the barrel of a gun. Out on an evening jog, an unsuspecting Chloe is dragged off into an alleyway…

videos.title: Let him turn!
videos.overview: When Maddie is rushed to hospital, Robbie and Chloe have to wonder: is she faking, or is her life in real danger? In a shocking confrontation, Dineo shows she’s done with playing by the Price rules.

videos.title: High risk
videos.overview: Maddie doesn’t deal well with saying farewell to Robbie. Sims and Stefan realise they’re targeting the wrong man in their mission. Dineo takes a big risk to give the stokvel project the boost it needs in order to succeed.

videos.title: Keep your friends close
videos.overview: Gordon makes a play to the board to limit Dineo’s power, but Dineo fights fire with fire. Maddie confesses to inducing her own illness to win back the Prices and Robbie. Chloe keeps her secret and Maddie’s plan reaps results.

videos.title: New beginnings
videos.overview: Maddie opens up to Robbie about her past. Stefan and Sims get closer to catching the big thieves redhanded. Dineo takes the plunge and gives the huge project the green light.

videos.title: Cable ties
videos.overview: Dineo’s campaign launches, and with her reputation hanging in the balance, Dineo watches the response numbers in shock. Maddie makes a last ditch effort to win Robbie over. But will confessing her sins backfire?

videos.title: Pop the cork!
videos.overview: Stefan and Sims handle the aftermath of their ordeal. Maddie returns to the Price Mansion and learns of Dineo’s antics that could prove problematic to her plans for Robbie.

videos.title: Cops and robbers
videos.overview: Robbie questions Dineo's hiring of Sefako. Stefan and Sims risk their lives in their pursuit of the copper thieves.

videos.title: What goes around...
videos.overview: Gordon asks for his job back from Dineo and is surprised by the response. Maddie tells Chloe she’s playing the long game with Robbie. Stefan and Sims are about to hand over their evidence to the cops when Stefan receives a threatening text.

videos.title: New death, new dawn
videos.overview: Stefan takes a bullet for Willem. Dineo floors the board with her proposal. Maddie apologises to Janet.

videos.title: Fighting back
videos.overview: With Stefan barely clinging to life, Willem must finally confront the role he played in Stefan’s predicament. As Dineo presses ahead with the sale of Legacy, the Price family must confront what the loss of Legacy means for their futures.

videos.title: Game on
videos.overview: Sims and Daphne make a breakthrough - it’s game on! Angelique makes a stunning discovery that threatens to change everything.

videos.title: Double trouble
videos.overview: Daphne and Sims team up to catch the copper racketeers, as Stefan lies in the hospital at death’s door, needing a miracle. As Dineo prepares to sell Legacy out to a foreign conglomerate, Angelique vows to prevent her - and gets to work.

videos.title: Pick your battles
videos.overview: Angelique is confident that she has succeeded in her plan to derail Dineo’s sale of Legacy, but Dineo has an unforeseen manouver of her own. Sims gets justice for Stefan, and Stefan returns from hospital to heal - both his body and his relationship with Willem.

videos.title: Careful what you wish for
videos.overview: Dineo does damage control. Stefan has an electrifying encounter. Msizi returns with a revelation.

videos.title: The fulcrum
videos.overview: Dineo holds fast to selling Legacy even in the face of Msizi’s arrival. Angelique finally accepts her fate even as Msizi gears up to fight. Sanele finds himself drawn deeper into the murky waters of unrequited love.

videos.title: New dawn looming
videos.overview: Angelique finds an unlikely ally. Stefan musters up the courage to ask Chanel out on a date. Gordon tries a new approach to the dating game.

videos.title: The art of seduction
videos.overview: Angelique and Sihle hatch a plan to get back at Dineo. Gordon tries to get out of his comfort-zone in dating while Stefan self sabotages his own love life.

videos.title: Finding the real deal
videos.overview: While Dineo tries to salvage her deal, Msizi and Angelique try to secure capital from two very different sources. Gordon is left feeling foolish after a one-night stand, and Sanele comes to a surprising revelation. Sims pushes Stefan into a startling confession about his feelings for Chanel.

videos.title: Patches and mis-matches
videos.overview: Angelique and Sihle’s alliance gains traction, and Dineo scrambles to save her deal. Sanele sets Gordon straight on some of his assumptions about him. Stefan tries to explain to Chanel why he backed out of pursuing her, but she rejects his reasons.

videos.title: Let's chat!
videos.overview: Dineo tries her best to convince Angelique and Sihle to stop interfering with the sale of Legacy. Stefan finally admits why he’s keeping Chanel at arms length and decides to face it head on. Sanele expresses how he feels to Gordon and leaves the ball in his court.

videos.title: New beginnings and old wounds
videos.overview: Dineo is forced to confront a new reality. Gordon and Sanele find themselves in a remarkable place. Stefan and Chanel find ‘taking it slow’ has it’s own speed.

videos.title: Walk away
videos.overview: Gordon has a surprise for Sanele, but is Patrick about to ruin the moment? When Stefan brings Chanel to meet the family, Willem sees something from his past.

videos.title: War and peace
videos.overview: The battle to purchase Legacy escalates and Angelique is unsettled by the intensity of Msizi’s anger towards Dineo. Sanele and Gordon get to know each other better by giving each other gifts. Maddie hopes to earn Janet’s trust and love but Janet remains sceptical.

videos.title: The devil you know
videos.overview: As Gordon tries his best to impress Sanele, Sanele gets the feeling Gordon is embarrassed about him. After much thought and pressure from Robbie, Janet gets some valuable advice from Cranston that benefits everyone involved concerning the Maddie situation.

videos.title: Things ain't never what they seem
videos.overview: Sihle and Angelique look sure to win their hostile take-over bid of Legacy, when Dineo plays them at their own game, leaving Sihle murderously angry. Gordon and Sanele clear up the uncertainties about where they stand with one another, and take their relationship to the next level.

videos.title: Death becomes her
videos.overview: Janet gets the evidence she needs to finally get Maddie out of Robbie’s life but it comes with a price. Dineo is not as satisfied with her win over Angelique as she thought she’d be. Gordon and Sanele take the next step in their relationship.

videos.title: The return
videos.overview: After Dineo’s attack, Sefako blames Sihle and Angelique and he issues a terrifying warning. With Janet still in a coma, Robbie battles grief, while Maddie hurries to tidy up the evidence against her… Gordon and Sanele’s relationship deepens, and Sanele extends a surprising invitation to Gordon.

videos.title: Pillow Talk
videos.overview: As Janet lies comatose and Robbie despairs, Maddie prepares her coup de grace. Gordon goes with Sanele to meet the Soweto family. Angelique and Sihle’s plotting is interrupted by the return of the prodigal daughter - Felicity is back!

videos.title: Acceptance
videos.overview: Felicity comes to terms with her mother’s terrible plot to save Legacy. Gordon gets to know the Potgieters a bit more. Robbie finds out the truth about what really happened with Janet.

videos.title: Living Skeletons
videos.overview: Dineo and Felicity’s reunion throws off more than just Felicity. Robbie puts a plan in motion to find Maddie.

videos.title: Long Goodbye
videos.overview: Robbie lays a trap to catch his mother’s would-be killer. As Dineo reconnects with Felicity, Angelique and Sihle reconsider their deadly plot.

videos.title: What is About to Happen Cannot be Stopped
videos.overview: Gordon is excited, but is he mutton dressed as haute couture lamb? The EGM ends in horror as the sniper finds a target.

videos.title: Hit and Run
videos.overview: Sefako and Robbie hunt down and catch the assassin who shot Felicity; and Angelique is torn between self-preservation and motherly love when she has to decide whether to escape the country and avoid arrest, or stay to care for Felicity in hospital.

videos.title: Walking Wounded
videos.overview: As Felicity embarks on the road to recovery, Gordon works to reunite their scattered family. As fallout from the shooting continues, Dineo brings terrible news to the Legacy board.

videos.title: New Beginnings
videos.overview: Gordon does his best to pull the family together. Felicity struggles to overcome her past and embrace the future that Dineo and Gordon want to forge.

videos.title: Paying the Price
videos.overview: Felicity makes the one choice that will finally release her. Stefan is set free, by both Felicity and his father. Dineo chooses the man she’ll rebuild the business with.
